ModMetaData.name: Rim Factions
ModMetaData.author: Rim Factions contributors
ModMetaData.description:
RimWorld with up to 4 friends on one planet, without constant desyncs: everyone plays their own save, and Rim Factions links the games.
- Friends' colonies on your world map; start new colonies on your friend's planet. - Gifts by drop pod: items, silver or colonists. - Trips: send colonists to help (AI or live) or raid (AI); survivors come home. - Start together on one map, then split off to found your own colony. - Goodwill news feed for gifts, help, raids, splits and relation changes.
Bundled with Prepatcher, Multiplayer and Multiplayer Compatibility (MIT, by Zetrith and the RimWorld Multiplayer Team).
